note: Optional Apache module integration of the existing source-built Jackson ObjectMapper with M3 decoded-file and compiler APIs. It does not promote the repository-wide receiving sequence.

mappings.target_rule: Preserve upstream API, module identity, descriptors and configuration semantics; add M3ObjectMapper as an optional subclass.

Immutable String atoms, adaptive occurrence handles, UTF-16 offsets and slices, forward Reader, bounded decoded admission, chunked Writer and direct writeTo. Jackson single-value and sequence I/O use these boundaries. Full native/search/postings/persistence file-plane migration remains separate.
Retain unsigned 8/16/32-bit handle boundaries with local package/class adaptation.
M3String is package-private. Use ordinary immutable String references so the selected M3VM owns storage. No independent spelling arena, String.intern call, or Synexia runtime dependency.

mappings.source: existing compiler-owned M3AST callback and projection API
mappings.target_rule: Capture detached TypeShape metadata through the actual M3AST Unit.project API. Preserve the original top-level projection; add an explicit named-member projection, typed Class/TypeReference/JavaType preparation and declaration-kind/record-signature checks. The actual ObjectMapper owns annotation, visibility and generic binding decisions.

pending_promotion_gates: Matched custom M3JDK build and UseM3StringStorage on/off execution
CPU, retained heap and process/native-memory measurements before performance claims
source_license_rule: Preserve individual upstream licenses and source provenance; adapter Apache-2.0; existing JDK compiler sources retain their own OpenJDK license.
